data.long_meaning: The name Fatiha is derived from the first Surah of the Holy Quran, which is also known as Al-Fatiha. The name Fatiha carries the meaning “Opening” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fatiha usually hope their child will grow to embody opening and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reciting Al-Fatiha invokes blessings from Allah, and it is often recited during daily prayers.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatiha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: فاتحة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم الفتحة مشتق من الفاتحة، وهي السورة الأولى في القرآن الكريم، وتعني الفتح أو البداية. وتعتبر الفتحة رمزًا للبداية الجديدة والانفتاح على الخير والرحمة.

in_urdu.name: فاطحہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاطحہ کا نام فاتحہ سے ماخوذ ہے، جو قرآن کریم کی پہلی سورة ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے فتح یا آغاز۔ فاطحہ کو ایک نئی شروعات اور خیر و رحمت کے لیے ایک علامت کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़ातिहा
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ातिहा नाम फातिहा से लिया गया है, जो कुरआन की पहली सूरह है। इसका अर्थ है खुलना या शुरुआत। फ़ातिहा को एक नई शुरुआत और अच्छाई और दया के लिए एक प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: فاټحه
in_pashto.long_meaning: فاټحه نوم د فاتحې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د قرآن کریم لومړۍ سورت ده. دا معنی لري پرانه یا پېل. فاټحه د یوې نوې پېل او د خیر او رحم لپاره یوې نښې په توګه ګڼل کیږي.

in_english.name: Fatiha
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fatiha is derived from the Arabic word 'Fatiha', which is the first surah of the Quran. It means 'opening' or 'beginning'. Fatiha is considered a symbol of new beginnings and is associated with goodness and mercy. The root 'F-T-H' in Arabic conveys the idea of opening or unfolding, reflecting the spiritual significance of the name in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: Fatiha is a popular name for Muslim boys. In Arabic literature, the term "fatiha" is used to denote the first chapter or the introduction of a book, and as such, the name holds a deep significance for Muslims as it is associated with the opening chapter of the Quran.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the word "Fatiha" refers to the opening or the beginning of something, especially in reference to the Quran. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that reciting Al-Fatiha (the opening chapter of the Quran) before starting any activity grants spiritual blessings and success in that endeavor. Consequently, the name Fatiha is believed to bestow upon its bearer the blessings and rewards of the Al-Fatiha Surah.
